newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens to invest in German unit.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens to invest in German unit.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Tuesday its German unit Hoogovens Aluminium Walzprodukte GmbH would invest 84 million marks in its rolling mill in the city of Koblenz.
Hoogovens said the modernisation of the plant would include the replacement of the existing 80 inch hot-rolling mill by an 128 inch mill.
"The new equipment will enable Koblenz to improve quality and reduce costs considerably," the Dutch group said, adding that the product range of the German unit would also be extended.
Hoogovens' rolled products are used in aerospace, high-speed ferries and other transport sectors. Special aluminium from the Koblenz plant is also used in automobile heat exchangers.
